result.title: Can Activation Steering Substitute for Prompt-Based Affective Priming in LLM Digital Twins?
result.comment: Code, generation logs and analysis scripts: https://github.com/JunyiTim/twin-activation-injection
result.summary: Affective priming -- asking participants to write about a recalled event, such as a time they felt grateful or lacked control, and then measuring the induced state and its spillover onto related judgments -- is a standard way to manipulate emotion in the social sciences, and it also shifts the responses of LLM-based digital twins. The writing task, however, requires generating a full text. We test whether activation steering can replace it. Using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on 100 personas in two domains (gratitude, lack of control), we compare a real-prompt path replicating the original Twin-2K-500 Mega Study (J2) with an injection path that skips the writing and adds a mean-difference direction, extracted from human writing, to the residual stream at varying strengths. The real-prompt effects fall between the original human and digital-twin effects in 5 of 6 comparisons. Injection shifts the manipulation check in a dose-dependent way and matches the real-prompt effect at one strength in the gratitude domain (beta ~ 2.7), but overshoots beyond it, on the proximal measure as well, and asymmetrically across the two directions. A structure-matched No-Injection baseline separates two sources of difference: omitting the writing task raises the proximal measure in both domains, whereas the injected direction itself moves a distal measure in the lack-of-control domain. Substitution is therefore measure-dependent: validity established for one way of inducing a state does not carry over uniformly to another.

AI.brief_summary: 论文检验激活引导能否替代提示式情感启动：在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 100 个人格上，将人类写作中提取的均值差方向注入残差流，并与真实写作提示路径比较效果及剂量反应。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「向残差流注入方向、按强度检验下游测量是否等价」的干预范式，可供核查 latent 状态是否真正承载任务信息及 latent 与显式推理轨迹的替代关系；但情感启动任务与 LVR 距离较远，需较多迁移判断。
